title: Microtubules contribute to this anesthetic response through non-quantum cellular mechanisms
description: The result is compatible with microtubules being a relevant anesthetic target without requiring quantum computation or a theory of consciousness.
would_change: Pre-registered replications across anesthetics and measures that separate motor behavior, arousal, and cognition.

title: Quantum states in neural microtubules generate conscious experience
description: The original authors discuss compatibility with microtubule-based quantum models, but the experiment did not measure the required quantum state or show that it causes experience.
would_change: Independent in-vivo demonstrations of the proposed quantum states, causal manipulation, reproducible links to conscious-state measures, and alternatives ruled out.

title: Consciousness is entangled with consciousness across the universe
description: No reviewed source supplies an operational definition, a direct measurement, or an independent test of this claim.
would_change: A precise, falsifiable prediction and independently replicated evidence that distinguishes the claim from conventional neural explanations.
